description: Primary screen where students record their daily win. This screen checks on load whether today's win already exists, and if so, disables the input field and save button while displaying the prevention message.

props.text: Primary screen where students record their daily win. This screen checks on load whether today's win already exists, and if so, disables the input field and save button while displaying the prevention message.
Shows today's date in a human-readable format, derived from device timezone
Text input field for entering achievement (1-150 characters). Disabled state when today's win already exists.
Button to save the achievement. Disabled or hidden when today's win already exists.
Message displayed when user has already recorded today's win: 'Today's win is already recorded. Come back tomorrow.'
Shows the achievement text that was already recorded for today
Success message shown after successfully saving a new win, displaying the saved achievement text
Displays error messages from failed save attempts, including duplicate entry errors
